title: Familiar Embodiment Verification Result Schema (familiar.embodiment_verification.v1)
description: JSON Schema for the textual (JSON) encoding of one Familiar Embodiment Verification Result (profile v1, OpenCoven/familiar-contract#17). Records the outcome of verifying an embodiment: alias resolution, issuance eligibility, or historical rehydration. Verdicts are explicit about degradation — a verifier MUST NOT overclaim historical continuity when required material is unavailable; it returns a degraded or unverifiable result. Revoked, invalid, unresolved, and cryptographically unverifiable revisions fail closed. This object is the explicit later-state record for revocation after binding commit: a committed binding is never retroactively mutated. Unknown members are rejected (fail closed).

schema.description: Profile discriminator; carries the verification-object schema version.

verificationId.description: Unique opaque identifier of this verification result.

question.description: What was verified: whether a revision/binding is eligible for issuance now (alias resolution, validity, principal match), or what a historical run actually embodied and how much of that can be rehydrated. A later identity revision does not rewrite which revision a historical run embodied — the historical question is answered from committed bindings and retained material, not from current registry state.

kind.description: What the verification was about: an alias input, an identity revision, or a committed binding.

alias.description: The alias as provided. Input convenience, never the root of trust. Records subject to minimization policy SHOULD reference the alias out-of-band instead of embedding it; embedding is a privacy decision recorded in privacyClass of the referenced binding where one exists.

familiarRootId.description: Resolved stable opaque familiar root identity.

bindingDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical encoding of the evaluated binding (the exact binding snapshot verified — the TOCTOU anchor).

subject.description: The subject evaluated by this verification.

verdict.description: verdict vocabulary. valid: fully verified. degraded: verified core with reduced evidence — continuity is attested only within the retained evidence's limits. unverifiable: required material is unavailable or an unsupported algorithm/policy prevents verification; fail closed, never treated as valid. invalid: affirmative negative evidence (revoked, stale, mismatched, ambiguous, unauthorized); fail closed.

reason.description: Ratified reason vocabulary. alias_ambiguous: alias resolution produced more than one root — refuse ambiguity. alias_unresolved: alias matches no root. stale_cached_revision: a stale resolver cache cannot silently produce an active binding. revision_revoked / revision_retired / revision_superseded: lifecycle state at decision time. principal_mismatch / scope_mismatch: the revision is not valid under the current principal or scope. digest_mismatch / integrity_mismatch: recomputation failed — tamper evidence, not a soft mismatch. lineage_unverifiable: same-familiar continuity cannot be machine-verified. bundle_missing / bundle_unauthorized / bundle_erased: rehydration evidence states. revocation_race: revocation detected between final validity check and binding commit. policy_rejected: the governing policy refuses this issuance. algorithm_unsupported: a named hash algorithm or canonicalization is not supported — reject, never skip.

identityDigestRecomputed.description: True only when the identity declaration digest was recomputed from retained canonical bytes and matched.

integrityRecomputed.description: True only when the binding integrity digest was recomputed over the canonical binding encoding and matched.

lineageVerified.description: True only when the lineage evidence chain was verified — same-familiar continuity and fork/succession semantics are machine-verifiable, not inferred from names or similar content.

bundleStatus.description: Retained historical bundle state for this verification: present (full retained bundle), partial (some components missing — degraded), erased (sensitive components erased under privacy policy; minimum integrity/audit evidence remains), missing (no retained bundle), unauthorized (caller not privacy-authorized to read the bundle), not_applicable (verification question does not consult retained material).

bundleComponentsChecked.description: Names of retained bundle components checked during rehydration.

observedStatus.description: Revision status observed in the identity registry at checkedAt — later state, recorded here rather than by mutating any committed binding. Null when no registry state was consulted.

redacted.description: True when this record was redacted under minimization/erasure policy after being recorded; redaction MUST be recorded, never silent.

checkedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC time of the verification.

verifierId.description: Identity of the resolver/verifier that produced this result.

policyVersion.description: Version of the validity/lifecycle policy under which this verdict was rendered. Verifiers MUST refuse (reason policy_rejected) results rendered under policy versions they do not support.

sha256Hex.description: Textual hash encoding per RFC-0001 §5.6.1: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (a raw 32-byte SHA-256 value), bare — no sha256: prefix, no uppercase.
